displayTitle: The Rooster and the Hen in the Hazelwood
description: Tuppen the Hen has a nutshell stuck in her throat, and the Rooster runs for water, but the Spring wants leaves first, and the Linden wants red-gold ribbons. A breathless Norwegian chain tale that grows longer at every stop.
summary: A devoted rooster races through a chain of bargains to bring water that will save his hen.
